AEM02.name: Endpoint metadata, MVC endpoint metadata, RouteEndpoint and IApiEndpointMetadata
key_ideas: Endpoint.Metadata is the unified endpoint-routing metadata bag.
Minimal APIs rely heavily on Endpoint.Metadata.
MVC endpoints can have both endpoint metadata and MVC ActionDescriptor.
IApiEndpointMetadata participates in API Explorer/OpenAPI-oriented metadata.
Metadata can come from attributes, conventions and endpoint builder calls.

AEM03.name: Ordered metadata and ordered endpoint metadata lookup
key_ideas: GetMetadata<T>() returns the effective item according to ordering semantics.
GetOrderedMetadata<T>() returns all matching metadata in order.
Group/convention/endpoint-local metadata can combine and override each other.

reading_quality.overall: Overall: medium-high. Code is small in places, but metadata concepts and API names are clear.
limitations: Some screenshots are tiny in contact sheet.
